title: Power-Grid Stability Simulator — Overview and definition
t: Power-Grid Stability Simulator — Overview and definition
description: Evaluates dynamic grid behavior under faults and renewable variability.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Evaluates dynamic grid behavior under faults and renewable variability. A grid stability simulator runs transient, small-signal, and frequency-domain studies of transmission networks with synchronous machines, inverters, and loads. Real implementations include PSS/E, PowerFactory, and ANDES. It checks N-1 contingencies, oscillatory modes, and frequency nadir after losses.
capabilities: Transient stability with detailed machine models
Inverter-based resource EMT and phasor models
